Top-seeded Elena Rybakina has withdrawn from the WTA Finals due to medical concerns ahead of the start of the year-end championships in Indian Wells, California.

“I’ve had an incredible season, but my body is just not physically ready to compete,” the 27-year-old said in a statement. “I’m going to spend some time resting and recovering at home and getting myself ready for the 2027 season.”

Rybakina is also sitting out the WTA 500 tournament in Tokyo in late October ahead of a quarterfinal matchup against Leylah Fernandez, noting neck inflammation and pain as the reason for her withdrawal.

The 27-year-old secured the year-end No. 1 ranking she first claimed by defeating Aryna Sabalenka in three sets in the U.S. Open final.

Rybakina earned her third Grand Slam title with the victory. It was also her second win against Sabalenka this year, after beating her in three sets at the Australian Open a few months earlier.

A win against Sabalenka in Riyadh last year led to a historic payday for Rybakina, making just under $5.3 million (£3,96M).

Rybakina won both Grand Slam tournaments and the Kazakhstani was looking to become the first player since Serena Williams in 2014 to win back-to-back titles at the WTA Finals with a win in Indian Wells.

The WTA Finals, which announced its relocation from the Middle East to California in July for safety reasons, will have to move on without the world’s No. 1 player.

World No. 10 Marta Kostyuk enters the eight-player draw as the first alternate and will face Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova on Sunday in the round-robin stage.

The alternate spot was originally going to go to six-time Grand Slam champion Iga Swiatek, but the world No. 9 decided to end what she calls “one of the most demanding seasons of her career” on Oct. 20, with a focus now on resting and recharging ahead of 2027.

Swiatek leads Kostyuk with 278 ranking points.
news.content: بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. النا ریباکینا رتبه اول به دلیل نگرانی های پزشکی قبل از شروع مسابقات قهرمانی پایان سال در ایندیان ولز، کالیفرنیا، از فینال WTA کناره گیری کرد. این بازیکن 27 ساله در بیانیه ای گفت: "من یک فصل باورنکردنی را پشت سر گذاشتم، اما بدنم از نظر فیزیکی برای رقابت آماده نیست." من مدتی را به استراحت و ریکاوری در خانه می گذرانم و خودم را برای فصل 2027 آماده می کنم. ریباکینا همچنین در تورنمنت WTA 500 در توکیو در اواخر اکتبر و پیش از مسابقه یک چهارم نهایی مقابل لیلا فرناندز شرکت می کند و التهاب و درد گردن را دلیل انصراف خود ذکر می کند. این بازیکن 27 ساله با شکست دادن آرینا سابالنکا در فینال 3 ست اوپن آرینا سابالنکا در سه ست سوم اوپن، رتبه 1 پایان سال را کسب کرد. عنوان اسلم با پیروزی. همچنین این دومین برد او در برابر سابالنکا در سال جاری بود، پس از شکست دادن او در سه ست در اوپن استرالیا چند ماه قبل. پیروزی برابر سابالنکا در ریاض در سال گذشته منجر به دستمزد تاریخی برای ریباکینا شد و چیزی کمتر از 5.3 میلیون دلار (396 میلیون پوند) به دست آورد. ریباکینا برنده هر دو تورنمنت گرند اسلم شد و قزاقستانی به دنبال تبدیل شدن به اولین بازیکن پس از سرنا ویلیامز در سال 2014 بود که عناوین پی در پی در فینال های WTA را با پیروزی در ایندین ولز به دست آورد. فینال WTA که در ماه جولای به دلایل ایمنی از خاورمیانه به کالیفرنیا نقل مکان کرد، باید بدون بازیکن No1Worta جهان حرکت کند.

Each week, the California Post will power rank the NBA’s 30 teams. Records are as of Saturday morning:

LeBron James is sipping fan’s wine. He’s dancing after making an and-one fadeaway jumper. The 76ers are atop the Eastern Conference, and the face of the league is having fun as he makes a run for his fifth ring. (Last week, 3rd)

Luka Doncic is putting up video game numbers, averaging 40.1 points, 7.8 rebounds and 7.7 assists for the Lakers, who are atop the Western Conference. He’s having an early MVP campaign. If he keeps playing this way, the Lakers could be a championship team. (Last week, 9th)

Victor Wembanyama had a 52-point, 24-rebound, eight-block performance against the Mavericks on Wednesday. When he’s on, he’s unstoppable for the Spurs, who have won seven games in a row. (Last week, 7th)

They’ve won three games in a row even though they’re without Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren and Cason Wallace because of injuries. This team is ridiculously deep, led by two-time reigning MVP Shai Gilegous-Alexander. (Last week, 6th)

No Anthony Edwards? No problem. The Timberwolves have won three games in a row even though their superstar has been sidelined after undergoing an arthroscopic right knee debridement procedure on Oct. 29. They beat the Rockets on Wednesday, 117-107. But missing Edwards’ 33.3 points per game is undoubtedly going to be tough. (Last week, 10th)

The Pistons have the best defensive rating in the NBA (103), and their only losses have been against the 76ers and the reigning champion Knicks. (Last week, 4th)

They have balanced scoring. They’re a good defensive team. Last week, they beat Oklahoma City and Boston before falling to the Timberwolves. (Last week, 1st)

Don’t sleep on this Celtics team. They’re in the top five in both offense and defense, and Jayson Tatum is showing that he can lead a team without Jaylen Brown. (Last week, 5th)

Damian Lillard and Deni Avdija have wasted no time developing chemistry. They already look like one of the most dynamic duos in the league, and they jumped to a 16-point lead over the Lakers on Friday before letting that advantage slip through their fingers in a 124-118 loss. (Last week, 8th)

Ty Jerome went from averaging 19.7 points last season to 27.4 this season. Cameron Boozer is deserving of his early Rookie of the Year buzz. The Grizzlies are surpassing expectations. (Last week, 2nd)

The Warriors have won six games in a row after dropping their first three contests. Steph Curry is still very much Steph Curry. Yaxel Lendeborg has wildly surpassed expectations. And this team could be dangerous, especially when Jimmy Butler returns from a torn ACL in the next few months. (Last week, 14th)

The Cavaliers routed the 76ers on Friday, 119-95, dealing them their first loss of the season. That’s a positive development for a team that has struggled against the stronger teams in the league this season, losing to the Thunder (twice), 76ers (in their season opener) and Hawks. (Last week, 13th)

The Hawks are solid offensively and defensively and have won three games in a row. This could be a sleeper team in the East. (Last week, 16th)

Yeah, yeah, they’ve had a surprisingly slow start to this season. But they’re the reigning champs and they’re going to figure it out. Jalen Brunson is coming off a 33-point performance (10-for-17 from the field, 5-for-10 from 3), and the Knicks have won two games in a row against the Nets and Bulls. They’re going to be just fine. (Last week, 17th)

Nikola Jokic is looking a little less Nikola Jokic-esque than usual, averaging his fewest points (23.4) and rebounds (9.7) since 2019-2020, as well as his fewest assists (9.3) since 2023-24. But here’s to betting that turns around real soon. (Last week, 15th)

Kawhi Leonard (left knee swelling) has begun a return-to-play process after playing in only two games this season. Him being back on the court will change things for this team. (Last week, No. 12th)

The Mavericks stunningly lost to the lowly Kings on Monday, 115-110. But they have wins over the Rockets and Thunder this season. Go figure. The Mavericks can be very good on any given night, and Cooper Flagg is just as good as they hoped. (Last week, 11th)

The Wizards lost two games in a row to the Hawks this week. They’re still trying to find their identity. But they have some good pieces in Trae Young and Anthony Davis, if those two can figure things out. (Last week, 18th)

Frustrations are brewing for the Heat, who have so much talent in Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bam Adebayo and Klay Thompson — but it’s not translating into wins. They dropped games this week against the Lakers and Warriors, and their defense has looked porous. At least Thompson hit a game-winning 3-pointer against the Clippers with one second left in a 117-116 overtime victory on Wednesday. (Last week, 20th)

The Pelicans won four games in a row before falling to the Timberwolves on Friday, 115-109. After dropping their first four games of the season, they even beat the Grizzlies on Monday in overtime, 135-134. Maybe they’re starting to turn things around? Probably not. (Last week, 25th)

Players have been in and out of the lineup with injuries, and the Pacers have lost five of their last six games. But with Tyrese Haliburton on the roster, this team can’t be counted out. (Last week, 22nd)

The Hornets are on a six-game losing streak, including suffering a 39-point route against the Celtics on Friday, 119-80. (Last week, 19th)

Dillon Brooks started drama with Draymond Green. Guess there’s some intrigue there. But otherwise, the Suns have fallen off the radar, losing four of their last five games. (Last week, 23rd)

The Magic have wins over a few strong teams: the Knicks and Raptors. But they’ve lost every other contest. (Last week, 21st)

The Clippers have been decimated by injuries and rocked by the Aspiration scandal. We weren’t expecting much from them this season. And there have been no surprises. (Last week, 24th)

At least New Yorkers have the Knicks. (Last week, 29th)

The Jazz have the injury bug, they can’t convert from beyond the arc and they’ve faced some of the league’s best opponents to start the season. Unsurprisingly, it hasn’t panned out well for them. (Last week, 26th)

They have the worst net rating and point differential in franchise history. It’s going to be a long rebuild. (Last week, 27th)

It’s been a rough season, but, hey, that win over the Mavericks on Monday was unexpected. (Last week, 30th)

Maybe Bucks fans can find a bit of consolation in the fact that Giannis Antetokounmpo is struggling in Miami? (Last week, 28th)

Venice Beach is getting a massive new music festival — with organizers planning to turn its iconic boardwalk and beachfront into a sprawling concert destination.

The two-day 1905 Fest is slated for fall 2027, promising five music stages, more than a dozen bars and plenty of food vendors along one of Southern California‘s most recognizable stretches of coastline.

The festival is the brainchild of Sam Meyers, a former director of BeachLife Festival, who says the event will pay tribute to Venice’s colorful history and the vision of its founder, Abbot Kinney.

“Named for the year Venice was founded, 1905 Fest celebrates that legacy with a new two-day festival of music, art, and culture on its iconic coastline,” the festival’s website states.

“Welcoming longtime Venetians, new neighbors, old friends, and everyone in between to be part of its next chapter.”

Meyers said the concept is rooted in his “interpretation of what Venice was founded on: having fun and building community.”

The sprawling event would be centered around Windward Plaza, near the famous Venice Skatepark and Boardwalk, extending onto the sand where Windward Avenue meets the Pacific Ocean.

Renderings posted to the festival’s website show a concert footprint stretching across both the beachfront and nearby streets, with five stages planned for the weekend.

Organizers are also envisioning a free fan zone along a temporarily closed street, giving local businesses an opportunity to attract festivalgoers, according to the Westside Current.

The musical lineup is expected to lean toward indie dance and psychedelic rock, although no performers have been announced.

Meyers, who has lived on the Westside for nine years and in Venice for eight, said he hopes to revive some of the community spirit he believes has defined the beachside neighborhood for generations.

“I’ve lived on the Westside for nine years, eight of them in Venice. I still believe in the spirit of what Kinney envisioned, even if that spirit can sometimes feel a little distant today,” Meyers said.

The ambitious proposal still has plenty of hurdles, but Meyers told the outlet he has received support from the offices of LA City Councilwoman Traci Park and LA County Supervisor Lindsey Horvath.

The festival has also secured permits and logistical support from the city, county and local district, according to the report.

Now Meyers is looking to get Venice residents on board, asking locals to share their ideas and suggestions before the festival takes shape. Locals can reach him via email here with their ideas and suggestions.

“What I want to do is unite the people who have lived in Venice for 50-plus years, the people who have lived in Venice for 20-plus years, and the people who just moved here,” Meyers said.

An exact date for the fall 2027 festival has not been announced. The California Post reached out to Meyers for additional details.
news.content:
پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود بیشتر مشاهده کنید. ساحل ونیز در حال برگزاری یک جشنواره موسیقی جدید عظیم است — با سازمان دهندگانی که قصد دارند پیاده‌روی نمادین و کنار ساحل آن را به مقصدی وسیع برای کنسرت تبدیل کنند. فستیوال دو روزه 1905 برای پاییز 2027 برنامه ریزی شده است و نویدبخش پنج مرحله موسیقی، بیش از ده ها بار و تعداد زیادی از فروشندگان مختلف مواد غذایی در جنوب کالیفرنیا است. این جشنواره زاییده افکار سام مایرز، مدیر سابق جشنواره بیچ لایف است که می گوید این رویداد به تاریخ رنگارنگ ونیز و دیدگاه بنیانگذار آن، ابوت کینی ادای احترام می کند. بزرگترین اخبار، نظر و فرهنگ در حال حاضر کالیفرنیا را شکل داده است. لطفاً یک ایمیل معتبر ارائه دهید. با کلیک کردن در بالا، با شرایط استفاده و خط مشی رازداری موافقت می کنید. در وب سایت جشنواره آمده است: «فست 1905 که به نام سال تاسیس ونیز نامگذاری شده است، این میراث را با یک جشنواره دو روزه موسیقی، هنر و فرهنگ در خط ساحلی نمادین خود جشن می‌گیرد.» با استقبال از ونیزی‌های دیرینه، همسایگان جدید، دوستان قدیمی و همه افرادی که در این بین هستند بخشی از فصل بعدی آن هستند.
میرز گفت که این مفهوم ریشه در "تفسیر او از آنچه ونیز بر اساس آن بنا شده است: تفریح ​​و ایجاد جامعه" است. این رویداد گسترده در اطراف میدان ویندوارد، در نزدیکی پارک اسکیت‌بازی و پیاده‌روی معروف ونیز برگزار می‌شود و روی شن‌هایی امتداد می‌یابد که خیابان ویندوارد با اقیانوس آرام تلاقی می‌کند. رندرهای ارسال شده در وب‌سایت جشنواره، ردپایی از کنسرت را نشان می‌دهد که در هر دو ساحل کشیده شده است.

news.originalContent:
See more of our coverage in your search results.

Energy drinks and stimulant-containing supplements have been linked to the risk of serious heart problems, including cardiac arrest and heart attacks, particularly among young adults.

That’s according to new research released by the American Heart Association, which will be presented at the AHA Scientific Sessions in Chicago, November 6–9, 2026.

A retrospective observational analysis looked at more than 28,000 reports submitted to the FDA of cardiovascular events, including cardiac arrest, myocardial infarction (heart attack), ventricular arrhythmias (abnormal rhythms), palpitations, tachycardia (rapid heart rate), chest pain and syncope (fainting).

Cardiac arrest appeared in reports involving caffeine– and stimulant-containing products about 11 times as often as in reports involving products without those ingredients.

Heart attacks were reported about 4.5 times as often, while ventricular arrhythmias (abnormal heart rhythms) or palpitations were reported about four times as often, according to the AHA.

Elevated heart rate, chest pain and fainting were also increased among the group consuming those substances.

Approximately 45% of reported cardiovascular events associated with stimulant products involved adults ages 18 to 34.

The stimulants included in the study were caffeine, methylxanthines, guarana, yerba mate, synephrine, yohimbine and other compounds. They were consumed in products such as soft drinks, meal replacement shakes, protein bars, smoothies and vitamins.

Colin Kane, M.D., pediatric cardiologist and service chief at Children’s Health and professor at UT Southwestern Medical Center, said the findings build on earlier case reports about potential heart risks from high caffeine intake.

“We’ve known through case reports and anecdotal evidence that caffeine in high amounts can be potentially dangerous to people with underlying heart conditions and even those who have normal hearts,” Kane, who was not involved in the study, told Fox News Digital.

It is generally safe for adults to consume up to 400 mg of caffeine per day, which equates to up to five 8-ounce cups of regular black caffeinated coffee, according to a 2026 American Heart Association Scientific Statement on caffeine and cardiovascular disease.

“Some energy drinks have up to three times more caffeine per fluid ounce than brewed coffee, and some pre-workout supplements have more than 12 times as much,” senior study author Dr. Pamela Benavidez, a cardiothoracic anesthesiologist at Fairfield Medical Center in Lancaster, Ohio, told Fox News Digital.

“This means one small serving can easily surpass the advised daily limit or more.”

Benavidez also warned that these products often include other stimulants like synephrine, yohimbine and methylhexanamine.

“These can interact with caffeine in ways that are not fully understood, especially in young, healthy people,” she said.

The researchers recommend that young people carefully monitor their consumption of caffeine and watch for heart-related symptoms, such as palpitations, chest pain or tightness, lightheadedness, fainting, or a racing or irregular heartbeat during or after use of these products.

“If you notice any of these symptoms, seek medical help right away,” Benavidez advised. “If you have a known heart condition, a family history of sudden cardiac events, or take medications that are classified as stimulants or can affect your heart rate/rhythm, you should talk to your doctor before using these products at all.”

Kane identified people with underlying heart conditions, particularly those with potentially dangerous heart rhythms and older adults with coronary artery disease, as groups needing particular awareness.

“And there’s a whole group of people who may have an underlying heart condition that they’re not diagnosed with yet,” he added.

The findings are preliminary and have not yet been published as a full peer-reviewed manuscript.

As the study was observational, it could only show an association and could not prove that the products caused the cardiac events.

“We don’t know how many people consumed these drinks and didn’t report symptoms or those who maybe had symptoms and didn’t report them,” Kane said.

Also, as the FDA reports were voluntary, they may contain incomplete, inconsistent or selectively submitted data.

It is possible that other factors, such as alcohol or drug use, strenuous exercise and undiagnosed heart conditions, may have contributed to the cardiovascular events.

“Anytime you’re mixing stimulants and other substances or medications, it can certainly bring up a potential for harm,” Kane said.

The American Beverage Association, based in Washington, DC, sent the below statement to Fox News Digital in response to the study.

“Energy drinks have been enjoyed by billions of people around the world for more than 30 years and are recognized as safe by government food safety agencies worldwide. The US.Food and Drug Administration, Health Canada, the European Food Safety Authority all relied on the highest quality science when they determined that a moderate daily intake of 400 milligrams of caffeine from all sources is safe for adults.”

“Energy drinks have less caffeine than coffeehouse coffee and no regulatory agency has found that their other ingredients interact harmfully with caffeine,” the statement concluded.

Andrea Wong, chief science officer of the Council for Responsible Nutrition in Washington, DC, also reacted to the study’s findings.

“Because the analysis does not account for how many consumers actually used these products, whether they were overused or misused, or even the amount of caffeine (or other ingredients) per serving, it cannot determine the incidence of cardiovascular events or quantify the associated risk,” she told Fox News Digital.

“Importantly, the reported 11-fold difference in cardiac arrest reporting does not mean consumers are 11 times more likely to experience cardiac arrest.”

Talk-show host Bill Maher marveled at Democrats’ victories in red America in his latest monologue — singling out the GOP’s stunning loss in the Texas Senate race to state Rep. James Talarico.

“For Republicans, losing Texas was like finding out your girlfriend is dating a lesbian. You knew she was unhappy – but you didn’t think she’d go that far,” the comedian said to laughs on the set of his “Real Time” show on HBO.

Maher also expressed surprise that his two-time White House dining companion, President Trump, accepted the election results.

“Don, are you okay?” he asked.

“You sound unwell — you’re not even going to fake it was rigged?” ribbing Trump for conceding the results rather than claiming the election was stolen.

Trump had repeatedly claimed throughout the campaign he won the 2016, 2020, and 2024 elections even though he lost in 2020 to Joe Biden

Maher also ran through some of the major Democratic upsets and the unresolved race in Alaska.

“Texas went. South Carolina. Kansas – Kansas! Mississippi. Alaska – well, you don’t know about Alaska. They’re still counting Dan Sullivans,” he quipped, in a reference to Sen. Dan S. Sullivan and Daniel R. Sullivan Jr., who are both losing to Democratic former Rep. Mary Peltola.

He also riffed on one of the weirder elements of the entire campaign: Trump’s repeated comments about Sen. John Husted’s (R-Ohio) posterior.

“Even the power of John Husted’s muscular a– could not turn Ohio,” Maher said of the former political battleground where Democrats won both the Senate race, with former Sen. Sherrod Brown, and the governor’s race, with Amy Acton.

He then played a clip of Trump saying at a rally: “I looked at his a–, and I said, ‘His a–, it’s like a pile of muscle.'”

“Yeah, and he lost to Sherrod Brown, a Democrat with a flabby a–,” Maher added at the tail end.

As for demographic swings that drove the blue wave, “Taylor Swift hasn’t lost this many white guys,” Maher said.

Maher also took aim at what he described as Republican efforts to undermine the vote, but celebrated the results:

“Even with the attempted rigging — and they did try to rig it in every different kind of way: mail-in balloting, intimidating the voters, all that s—. Democracy, man, kind of f—ing awesome!”

See more of our coverage in your search results.

The family of a slain NYPD officer is fighting  to keep the thug  convicted of pushing him to his death from a New York City rooftop behind bars, The Post has learned.

Repeat offender Eddie Matos, who’s in prison for murdering Midtown South Officer Anthony Dwyer in 1989, is up for his fifth parole hearing in three years, according to the slain officer’s family and the Police Benevolent Association.

Dwyer’s sister, Maureen Brissett, was expecting her brother’s killer’s next hearing to happen in February –- until she got a call last week informing her that a new hearing was scheduled for Nov. 6.

The Parole Board denied Matos’ bid to get out of jail after an October 2025 appearance, citing Dwyer’s killing “together with your sustained pattern of serious institutional misconduct, including violent and weapons-related infractions” in prison.

The decision also cited “multiple convictions in Connecticut for burglary, larceny and theft of a firearm” prior to the burglary and cop killing in Times Square, the records show.

Matos, who’s serving 25 years to life at the maximum-security Green Haven Correctional Facility in Dutchess County, was granted this month’s do-over with the pro bono help of lawyer Isaac Zaur, a partner at the Madison Avenue law firm Clarick Gueron Reisbaum.

The new hearing was ordered by the Dutchess County Supreme Court after Zaur argued that the board had “relied on an impermissible mischaracterization” of Matos’ record in prison, according to court paperwork.

In appealing for a new hearing, the lawyer argued that Matos hasn’t received any disciplinary reports since 2019 and that his only two tickets since 2013 were for “talking in the hallway,” court paperwork shows.

Zaur didn’t respond to messages seeking comment.

“I just feel like, they’re doing this just for him to keep getting more chances and thinking that, my family’s gonna just say, ‘That’s enough,’” Brissett said the day before the hearing in Midtown. “But he’s sadly mistaken because that’s not ever going to happen.”

Brissett, who was 11 when her brother was killed, attended the hearing with her brother, her 18-year-old son and her 16-year-old daughter. Her 85-year-old mother, who has lung cancer, was unable to make it.

Victims’ families can read their impact statements at the hearings but cannot communicate directly with the inmate.

Inmates get hearings every two years but “de novo” hearings can be ordered by courts when the board’s decisions are appealed.

Forty-three cop killers statewide have been released since 2017, thanks to new rules that allowed the left-leaning state Parole Board to put less weight on the crime committed and more on an inmate’s prison record, the PBA said. The board’s members were mostly appointed by then-Gov. Andrew Cuomo.

“The Parole Board has done the right thing by denying this cop-killer’s parole again and again, but his lawyer keeps trying to game the system,” PBA President Patrick Hendry told The Post this week.

Dwyer, 23, and two other cops responded to a call about an armed robbery at a McDonald’s on Seventh Avenue and West 40th Street in Times Square on Oct. 17, 1989, and saw Matos fleeing.

Dwyer chased Matos to the roof.

“As soon as my brother got up there, Matos was waiting and kicked him down an air shaft and then escaped,” Brisett said. The police officers who reached Dwyer first said the dying cop told them Matos pushed him.

Dwyer plunged 40 feet and later died at Bellevue Hospital.

Matos, 58, was sentenced in 1990 to 25 years to life for second-degree murder and has been denied parole more than a dozen times.

“The Dwyer family can’t run to court to get a second chance to see Anthony,” Hendry said. “There is absolutely no reason his killer should be given endless do-overs in his quest to get out of jail. This cop-killer and his supporters are clearly trying to grind this hero family down until they give up, but we are not going to allow that to happen.”

A parole board decision could take weeks or more. If Matos loses again, he is due for another regular hearing in February, the PBA and family said.

Brissett and her mother want to see Matos behind bars for the rest of his life.

news.originalContent:
Bomb hoaxes and supermarket cyberattacks are heightening security fears.

Italy says civilian infrastructure in Europe is “under attack”.

A series of bomb threats this week grounded flights and put airports on high alert. No explosives were found, and the threats appear to be false.

But the disruption is not limited to aviation. Hackers have also targeted supermarket freezers in several countries, raising temperatures and spoiling food.

Together, the incidents are raising fears and questions about a wider campaign of hybrid attacks.

Who could be behind these threats? Are they connected? And can European nations come together to counter these acts of aggression?

Presenter: Dareen Abughaida

Eric Schouten – Founder and CEO of Dyami Security Intelligence

Dennis-Kenji Kipker – Research director of the Cyber Intelligence Institute

Patrick Bury – Defence and security specialist at the University of Bath
news.content:
تقلب های بمب و حملات سایبری سوپرمارکت ها ترس های امنیتی را تشدید می کند. ایتالیا می گوید زیرساخت های غیرنظامی در اروپا "تحت حمله" قرار گرفته است. یک سری تهدیدات بمب گذاری در این هفته پروازها را متوقف کرد و فرودگاه ها را در حالت آماده باش قرار داد. هیچ ماده منفجره ای پیدا نشد و به نظر می رسد تهدیدها نادرست هستند. اما اختلال به حمل و نقل هوایی محدود نمی شود. هکرها همچنین فریزرهای سوپرمارکت ها را در چندین کشور هدف قرار داده اند که باعث افزایش دما و فاسد شدن مواد غذایی شده است. این حوادث با هم ترس و سؤالاتی را در مورد کمپین گسترده تر حملات هیبریدی ایجاد می کند. چه کسی می تواند پشت این تهدیدها باشد؟ آیا آنها متصل هستند؟ و آیا کشورهای اروپایی می توانند برای مقابله با این اقدامات تجاوزکارانه گرد هم آیند؟ مجری: درین ابوقاعده

(Screenshot/YouTube/PowerfulJRE)

During an appearance on the “Joe Rogan Experience” podcast released Friday, a former adviser to Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy warned the free market may be at stake if the nation does not reform its institutions.

“Are we at a time right now where it feels like we’re just going to be status quo for the next four years?” former Kennedy adviser Calley Means told host Joe Rogan. “I’m worried about socialists taking over because I think unless the Republican Party actually has an anti-corruption plan to actually fix this, Americans are going to vote for a different solution.” The interview was released days after Republicans lost their majorities in both chambers of Congress following Tuesday’s midterm elections. (RELATED: ‘Concentrated Group Of People In White House’ Sold Out For Special Interests, Former Advisor Says)

Means also told Rogan the Republican response to socialism should be, “Oh, we, you know, support free markets.”

“We don’t have a free market in healthcare. We don’t have a free market in agriculture. We don’t have a free market in housing,” Means continued. “If the Republican Party does not listen to what Trump said during the campaign, stop trying to subvert him, but actually — you know — try to do what he said and resonate with voters on— we’re screwed. Before you have a free market, you have to fix the structural problem.”

Means noted that this observation, which he said President Donald Trump campaigned on, is similar to what people like Democratic New York Rep. Alexandria Ocasio Cortez and Democratic Michigan Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed have been saying.

“My thesis is I think Trump … can save his presidency, can change staff, and get back on more of — you know — an America First fighting position against the swamp and get a lot done and maybe with the Democrats,” Means later said. “I think President Trump wants to be a historic figure and realizes that it’s gone off-course for true reform.”

Means later said Trump knows Congress is broken.

“He [Trump] needs to go to war with Congress, go to war with the Senate — you know — take some of the new ‘Lefties’ at their word that they are not taking corporate money and really want to drive institutional reform,” Means said.

He also argued Trump’s best way to do that would be by meeting with Independent Vermont Sen. Bernie Sanders and El-Sayed.

“They ran on a Trump message,” Means continued. “Like, if you close your eyes and listen to what the socialists are saying, ‘Oh no, we don’t want to do socialist stuff. We don’t want to do DEI stuff. We want to help the middle class. We want to combat the swamp.’ … They are running as Trump.”

Means, who reportedly brokered the alliance between Trump and Kennedy during the 2024 presidential election, resigned Oct. 22 from the White House.

White House spokeswoman Allison Schuster told the Daily Caller News Foundation that the Make America Healthy Again (MAHA) coalition “found a champion in President Trump” after “years of being on the political sidelines.”

“The Administration has already secured extensive victories for the MAHA Agenda, including overhauling the dietary guidelines for Americans, axing artificial ingredients in our food supply, and investing in regenerative farming,” she continued. “President Trump and Secretary Kennedy continue to work around the clock to deliver more wins for the American people.”

Neither Means, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, nor El-Sayed’s campaign immediately responded to the DCNF’s requests for comment.

میز ادامه داد: ما در حوزه بهداشت و درمان بازار آزاد نداریم، در کشاورزی بازار آزاد نداریم، در مسکن هم بازار آزاد نداریم. اگر حزب جمهوری خواه به سخنان ترامپ در طول مبارزات انتخاباتی گوش نمی دهد، از تلاش برای براندازی او دست بردارید، اما در واقع - می دانید - سعی کنید آنچه را که او گفت و با رای دهندگان طنین انداز کنید - ما دچار مشکل شده ایم. قبل از اینکه بازار آزاد داشته باشید، باید مشکل ساختاری را برطرف کنید.

news.originalContent:
Former army chief has 28 days to build a coalition that would end Benjamin Netanyahu’s long tenure as prime minister.

Israel’s President Isaac Herzog has tasked Gadi Eisenkot with forming the country’s next government, passing over the former army chief’s rival, Benjamin Netanyahu.

Herzog told Eisenkot of his decision on Saturday evening and will formally hand him the mandate at a ceremony on Sunday, the president’s spokesperson said.

Herzog held consultations with political parties this week to decide who he would appoint to form a government after neither side secured a majority in the October 27 general election.

Some 67 lawmakers, including from Arab-led parties, endorsed Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party, to form the next government, while only 46 backed Netanyahu, the current prime minister.

Eisenkot will have 28 days – with a possible 14-day extension – to build a coalition of at least 61 of the Knesset’s 120 seats, the minimum threshold for a government.

In the October election, Eisenkot’s four-party alliance won 48 seats, while Netanyahu’s right-wing and religious bloc secured 53, leaving both short of the 61 needed for a parliamentary majority. Arab-led parties, representing Palestinian citizens of Israel, won a record 19 seats.

Eisenkot has ruled out forming a government with the Arab-led parties, which would give him a 67-seat bloc. Winning over the two ultra-Orthodox parties, United Torah Judaism and Shas, would give him exactly 61 seats.

He could also form a government with fewer than 61 seats if he wins a parliamentary confidence vote.

Al Jazeera’s Nour Odeh, reporting from Ramallah in the occupied West Bank on Herzog’s decision, said the president “took the predictable route” in selecting Eisenkot, as he had the highest number of recommendations.

“The hard work will begin now for Eisenkot to put together a government that can pass a vote of confidence at the Knesset that: one, will not break too many of the promises he made on the campaign trail; and two, that can survive the opposition of the right-wing bloc led by Netanyahu,” Odeh said.

If Eisenkot fails to form a government within the allotted time, Herzog will nominate another candidate. If the second nominee fails, a parliament majority can back a third candidate, who will be granted a final 14 days.

If, once again, no government is formed, a new election will be called within 90 days, with Netanyahu staying on as a caretaker prime minister.

Eisenkot led Israel’s military from 2015 to 2019 and sat as an observer in Netanyahu’s war cabinet for the first eight months of Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, which began in October 2023.

Ahmad Tibi, a senior member of the Joint List – a coalition of Arab-led parties that holds 11 seats – told Al Jazeera on Saturday that Herzog’s decision was “expected”.

“We were concerned that the president would move towards a national unity government,” he said, referring to a proposed power-sharing agreement between Eisenkot and Netanyahu.

Instead, Arab-led parties endorsed Eisenkot for the mandate, granting him a “considerable margin”.

Tibi said he believes Eisenkot is headed for a minority government “with external support from the Arab parties”.

While this would not be a “dream government” for Arab-led parties, Tibi prioritised bringing down “the government of Netanyahu, [Itamar] Ben-Gvir and [Bezalel] Smotrich”.

Hours before Herzog’s decision, Netanyahu had warned that a government formed by the opposition bloc with support from Arab-led parties would lead to Israel’s collapse.

“Such a government, dependent on Islamists, will dismantle the state of Israel from within, as is happening in European countries, and far worse than that,” Netanyahu said in a prerecorded video speech, echoing the language of far-right politicians who falsely claim parts of Europe have come under Islamic law.

Netanyahu “described us as supporters of terrorists and terrorism”, Tibi said. “My response to him is this: Netanyahu is the biggest terrorist in Israel and the region, and the foremost supporter of terrorism, particularly Jewish terrorism in the West Bank and the Palestinian territories.”

Al Jazeera’s Odeh noted that although Eisenkot has expressly said he does not wish to form a government with Arab-led parties, “they both share quite compelling reasons to get rid of Netanyahu”.
news.content: رئیس سابق ارتش 28 روز فرصت دارد تا ائتلافی را ایجاد کند که به دوره طولانی مدت بنیامین نتانیاهو به عنوان نخست وزیر پایان دهد. آیزاک هرتزوگ، رئیس جمهور اسرائیل، گادی آیزنکوت را مأمور تشکیل دولت بعدی کشور کرده است. سخنگوی رئیس جمهور در مراسمی روز یکشنبه گفت. هرتزوگ این هفته رایزنی هایی با احزاب سیاسی انجام داد تا تصمیم بگیرد که چه کسی را برای تشکیل دولت منصوب می کند، پس از اینکه هیچ یک از طرفین در انتخابات عمومی 27 اکتبر اکثریت را به دست نیاوردند. حدود 67 قانونگذار، از جمله از احزاب تحت رهبری عرب، آیزنکوت، رهبر حزب یاشار، را برای تشکیل دولت بعدی تایید کردند، در حالی که تنها 46 نفر از نتانیاهو، نخست وزیر فعلی حمایت کردند. آیزنکوت 28 روز - با یک تمدید احتمالی 14 روزه - برای ایجاد ائتلافی با حداقل 61 کرسی از 120 کرسی کنست، حداقل آستانه برای یک دولت، فرصت خواهد داشت. در انتخابات اکتبر، ائتلاف چهار حزبی آیزنکوت 48 کرسی به دست آورد، در حالی که حزب نتانیاهو 1 کرسی از جناح راست و 5 کرسی مذهبی لازم داشت. اکثریت پارلمانی احزاب تحت رهبری عرب که به نمایندگی از شهروندان فلسطینی اسرائیلی حضور دارند، رکورد 19 کرسی را به دست آوردند. آیزنکوت تشکیل دولتی با احزاب تحت رهبری عرب را رد کرده است که به او 67 کرسی می دهد. پیروزی بر دو حزب افراطی ارتدوکس، یهودیت متحد تورات و شاس، دقیقاً 61 کرسی به او می‌دهد. او همچنین می‌تواند

news.originalContent:
Tear gas fired in Paris and Lyon as interior minister warns authorities are ‘ready and waiting’ for rioters and looters.

Tens of thousands of people have protested across France for a fourth consecutive weekend, in another show of anger against the government.

About 146,000 people rallied across the country to protest against the rising cost of living on Saturday, including 46,000 in Paris, the Ministry of the Interior said.

Unions put the figure at 250,000 protesters nationwide, with 75,000 in the capital.

The demonstrations come just days after an estimated 575,000 people took part in a rally organised by trade unions.

About 70,000 security personnel were deployed across the country on Saturday, with Interior Minister Laurent Nunez warning that authorities would be “ready and waiting” for anyone engaging in rioting or looting.

Clashes broke out between police and some protesters in the capital, Paris, despite a lower turnout than in previous weeks.

Footage posted online by the CLPRESS news agency showed police charging at protesters and using tear gas in an attempt to disperse the crowds. A police officer was also seen hitting a protester with a baton.

Police said a group of 200 individuals attacked officers as they were arresting a man who had set fire to a rubbish bin in a square in Paris, the AFP news agency reported.

In the southeastern city of Lyon, police also fired tear gas to disperse several hundred people in the city centre who were blocking a road during an unauthorised gathering.

Reporting from the French capital, Al Jazeera’s Natacha Butler said people working in a variety of jobs attended Saturday’s demonstrations in support of the student-led movement.

“I spoke to one railway worker who told me it was really important to be here today. He said not only was it important to protest against the cost of living, but that it was also important to support young people,” Butler said.

“There is no doubt that the trade unions, who’ve been weakened in recent years, really feel there is a sense of momentum,” she said. “Many of the workers that I’ve been speaking to say this is their time to really press the government for higher salaries and better facilities.”

The demonstrations in France began in September over poor conditions and a lack of resources at French high schools. The protests later expanded to encompass a host of grievances, linked to worsening living standards. The movement continues to be led by France’s students, but people of all ages have been taking part.

This weekend’s protests take place against the backdrop of France’s upcoming presidential election, due to be held in April. Polls put far-right candidate Marine Le Pen of the National Rally first, followed by far-left candidate Jean-Luc Melenchon of the France Unbowed party.

Melenchon unveiled his programme on Saturday to some 17,000 supporters and promised to do the opposite of incumbent President Emmanuel Macron.

He pledged to stimulate the economy by capitalising on consumer spending and “through billions [of euros] that already exist”, adding that these savings “must be channelled towards our country’s ecological and social needs”.

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Andrew Harnik/Getty Images)

Interior Secretary Doug Burgum wants to rein in the size of conservation zones on federal land that ranchers, miners and others share.

The Interior Department said Thursday in a press release that it wants to rewrite the planning rules the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) has followed since 1979 and “right-size” its Areas of Critical Environmental Concern (ACECs). The proposal is not yet final and will get 60 days of public comment once it appears in the Federal Register, the department said.

The department said in the release that the BLM would focus on what each designation is meant to protect “rather than on oversized buffer zones when those lands are supposed to be managed for multiple use.”

The BLM said in a May final rule that it manages about 245 million acres, roughly a tenth of all U.S. land. A Ford-era 1976 law, the Federal Land Policy and Management Act (FLPMA), generally requires that acreage to serve “multiple use.” As the BLM puts it, that means balancing uses such as grazing, timber, mineral development and recreation along with scenic, scientific and historic values.

“Public lands are set aside for the benefit and use of the American people,” Burgum said in the release. “They should be managed by the people closest to the land, not held back by outdated bureaucracy in D.C.”

“By empowering state and local leaders and cutting decades-old red tape, we’re making it easier to conserve our natural resources, boost production and create a more affordable and abundant supply of food and energy for American families,” he added.

ACECs cover public lands where “special management attention is required to protect and prevent irreparable damage” to historic, scenic or cultural values, fish and wildlife or natural systems, according to the BLM’s website, which cites FLPMA. They can also shield people from natural hazards. (RELATED: Trump Admin’s Energy Plans Clash With Solar Giant)

As of Sept. 30, 2025, the BLM had 1,172 sites listed as ACECs or research natural areas. They covered about 24.3 million acres combined, according to the agency’s yearly Public Land Statistics report.

That total was about 2.7 million acres higher than a year earlier, when the BLM counted 1,171 such sites covering about 21.5 million acres, according to its 2024 report. The agency notes that its acreage figures fluctuate as its land database is refined and updated.

The Interior Department said in written answers to the House Natural Resources Committee after an April 2023 hearing that 254 of the 377 ACECs the BLM designated over the previous 10 years came in 2016 alone. That was President Barack Obama’s last full year in office.

No other year in that span came close. The next highest was 2015, with 97 designations, according to the same answers.

The Interior Department, the Public Lands Council, The Wilderness Society and the Center for Western Priorities did not immediately respond to the Daily Caller News Foundation’s requests for comment.

Jonathan Wood, vice president of law and policy at the Property and Environment Research Center, a group that pushes market-based conservation, told the DCNF that ACECs “often include buffers surrounding them.” The rule text isn’t public yet, so Wood said he was going off the department’s release.

An ACEC set up for one cultural site will still take in “some area around it,” he said. Near oil and gas development, “some of these buffer zones can be pretty significant” because the impacts of a spill or accident “could be further reaching than other types of uses,” Wood added.

He doesn’t expect a hard acreage limit on individual ACECs, Wood said, but added that was only a guess.

“What I suspect they will do, and what’s probably the safer approach, is to set in the rules some guidance on how to set buffer zones and making the process somewhat more demanding, the bigger an ACEC is,” he said.

Tom Pyle, president of the American Energy Alliance, told the DCNF that anything “the Trump administration can do to retain the mission of the BLM lands is good.”

“BLM lands, by their very nature, are multiple use, are designated for multiple use, and for years and years and years, the Democrats, the Biden administration, the Obama administration before that, has systematically tried to lock up those lands and prevent that multiple use function of those lands,” Pyle said.

Aaron Johnson, vice president of public and legislative affairs at Western Energy Alliance, said in a statement to the DCNF that the group cannot weigh in on details until the proposed rule is posted.

But the alliance, which speaks for independent oil and gas producers in Western states, is “pleased that Interior is looking to address abuses of how Areas of Critical Environmental Concern have been used in the past,” he said.

“They were a backdoor land grab by the previous administration, which proposed closing off more than 2.1 million acres through various land management plans in western states where energy is produced,” Johnson added.

“ACECs are a legitimate tool under federal law, but they should be carefully targeted to protect resources that warrant special management, not used to broadly restrict multiple-use public lands,” he continued.

“The current planning process is too slow, too complicated and weighed down by outdated requirements,” BLM Director Steve Pearce said in the release. “These proposed changes would help the BLM make decisions more efficiently, reduce costs for taxpayers and improve coordination with the people and communities that rely on public lands.”

The department said in the release that the planning rules have been changed just twice since 1979, mostly to deal with cooperating agencies and outdated provisions.

It also said the rewrite would track FLPMA more closely, cut duplicate requirements, update some planning terms and strip out program-specific procedures that belong elsewhere in agency regulations.

The federal regulatory agenda lists the rulemaking as deregulatory under a Trump executive order. Its entry says the rule “will provide clarification of the process the BLM uses for designating Areas of Critical Environmental Concern.”

Back in May, the administration scrapped the Biden-era Conservation and Landscape Health Rule, better known as the Public Lands Rule. When that repeal took effect June 11, the ACEC rules reverted “to the framework in place since 1983,” according to the Federal Register. (RELATED: First Oil And Gas Lease Sales On Public Lands Yield Nearly $40,000,000 In Early Win For Trump Administration)

The 2024 rule had rewritten the ACEC regulations “to better meet FLPMA’s requirement that the BLM prioritize designating and protecting” the zones, its Federal Register summary said.

Many commenters saw the ACEC provisions in the 2024 rule as regulatory overreach and worried they “would lead the BLM to make overly broad ACEC designations that would incidentally — or even intentionally — crowd out productive uses of the public lands,” the BLM wrote in the May rescission.

Opponents of the rescission cast those provisions as “necessary updates to improve designation processes,” the agency added.

The Property and Environment Research Center urged the BLM in a Nov. 10, 2025, comment to keep the 2024 rule’s conservation leasing provisions, calling such agreements “a free-market tool to reduce conflict and encourage voluntary conservation on public lands.” The group rejected the agency’s position that conservation falls outside FLPMA’s meaning of “use.”

“I think BLM is simply wrong,” Wood told the DCNF. He also noted the agency “confused use of land with use of particular resources on that land.”

The BLM “may, in a separate process, pursue further rulemaking to address the ACEC regulations in a manner that could address some of the issues raised,” the agency wrote in May.

Development can continue inside an ACEC, though “additional information may be needed to ensure that a proposed project or activity will be consistent with special management attention,” the BLM says on its website.

When the full text comes out, Wood said people “should look for how much the rules seek to impose policy from above.”

The BLM will hold an online information session on the proposal Dec. 3 at 5 p.m. Mountain Time, according to the release.

(عکس از اندرو هارنیک/گتی ایماژ)
داگ بورگوم، وزیر کشور، می‌خواهد اندازه مناطق حفاظت‌شده در زمین‌های فدرال را که دامداران، معدن‌کاران و دیگران به اشتراک می‌گذارند، مهار کند. وزارت کشور پنجشنبه در بیانیه‌ای مطبوعاتی گفت که می‌خواهد قوانین برنامه‌ریزی‌ای را که اداره مدیریت زمین (BLM) از سال 1979 دنبال کرده است، بازنویسی کند و مناطق حیاتی محیط‌زیست خود را «اندازه مناسب» کند. این وزارتخانه گفت: این پیشنهاد هنوز نهایی نشده است و به محض اینکه در ثبت فدرال ظاهر شد، 60 روز نظر عمومی را دریافت خواهد کرد. این وزارتخانه در انتشار اعلام کرد که BLM بر روی آنچه قرار است هر نامگذاری برای محافظت تمرکز کند، "به جای مناطق حائل بزرگ، زمانی که آن زمین ها قرار است برای استفاده چندگانه مدیریت شوند."
BLM در قانون نهایی ماه مه گفت که حدود 245 میلیون هکتار، تقریباً یک دهم کل زمین های ایالات متحده را مدیریت می کند. قانون سال 1976 مربوط به دوره فورد، قانون فدرال سیاست و مدیریت زمین (FLPMA)، عموماً آن زمین را ملزم به استفاده از "چند کاربری" می کند. همانطور که BLM بیان می کند، این به معنای متعادل کردن کاربری ها مانند چرا، الوار، توسعه مواد معدنی و تفریح ​​همراه با ارزش های دیدنی، علمی و تاریخی است. بورگوم در این انتشار گفت: "زمین های عمومی برای منافع و استفاده مردم آمریکا کنار گذاشته شده است." آنها باید توسط نزدیکترین افراد به سرزمین مدیریت شوند، نه اینکه توسط بوروکراسی قدیمی در دی سی مانع شوند.»
«با توانمندسازی رهبران ایالتی و محلی و کاهش تشریفات اداری ده‌ها ساله، حفظ منابع طبیعی و افزایش تولید را آسان‌تر می‌کنیم.

اسحاق هرتسوگ، رئیس‌جمهور اسرائیل، پس از رایزنی با رهبران احزاب سیاسی، گادی آیزنکوت را برای تشکیل دولت جدید انتخاب کرده است. قرار است حکم رسمی ماموریت او روز یکشنبه اعطا شود. این تصمیم در حالی گرفته شده که هیچ‌یک از ائتلاف‌های اصلی در انتخابات اخیر نتوانسته‌اند اکثریت لازم را در پارلمان به دست آورند.

news.originalContent:
اسحاق هرتسوگ، رئیس‌جمهور اسرائیل، پس از رایزنی با رهبران احزاب سیاسی، گادی آیزنکوت را برای تشکیل دولت جدید انتخاب کرده است. قرار است حکم رسمی ماموریت او روز یکشنبه اعطا شود. این تصمیم در حالی گرفته شده که هیچ‌یک از ائتلاف‌های اصلی در انتخابات اخیر نتوانسته‌اند اکثریت لازم را در پارلمان به دست آورند.

هرتسوگ گفت که در رایزنی‌های انجام‌شده، گادی آیزنکوت، رهبر بلوک مخالف دولت بنیامین نتانیاهو، بیشترین حمایت نمایندگان احزاب را برای تشکیل دولت به دست آورده است.

دفتر ریاست‌جمهوری اسرائیل در بیانیه‌ای اعلام کرد: «رئیس‌جمهور، گادی آیزنکوت، رهبر حزب یاشار، را از تصمیم خود برای مامور کردن او به تشکیل دولت مطلع کرده است.»

در این بیانیه آمده است که حکم رسمی ماموریت تشکیل دولت روز یکشنبه، طی مراسمی در اقامتگاه ریاست‌جمهوری در بیت‌المقدس، به آیزنکوت اعطا خواهد شد.

در انتخابات ۲۷ اکتبر اسرائیل، حزب لیکود به رهبری بنیامین نتانیاهو با کسب ۲۷ کرسی به بزرگ‌ترین حزب پارلمان تبدیل شد، اما ائتلاف احزاب ملی‌گرا و مذهبی حامی او در مجموع تنها ۵۳ کرسی از ۱۲۰ کرسی کنست را به دست آورد.

چهار حزب تشکیل‌دهنده بلوک مخالف به رهبری آیزنکوت نیز ۴۸ کرسی کسب کردند. حزب یاشار به رهبری او با ۲۱ کرسی دومین حزب بزرگ پارلمان شد.

در این میان، دو حزب نماینده شهروندان عرب اسرائیل در مجموع ۱۹ کرسی به دست آوردند؛ رقمی بی‌سابقه که می‌تواند به آنها نقشی تعیین‌کننده در تشکیل دولت جدید بدهد.

اگرچه آیزنکوت تاکنون از ائتلاف با احزاب عرب خودداری کرده است، رهبران این احزاب در رایزنی‌های خود با رئیس‌جمهور از مأمور شدن او برای تشکیل دولت حمایت کردند. همین حمایت باعث شد که آیزنکوت بیشترین توصیه‌ها را از سوی نمایندگان پارلمان دریافت کند.

آیزنکوت پس از اعلام تصمیم رئیس‌جمهور در شبکه ایکس نوشت: «اکنون زمان تشکیل دولت اضطراری ملی است. تمام تلاشم را خواهم کرد تا شایسته این مسئولیت باشیم.»

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

آیزنکوت پس از دریافت حکم رسمی، ۲۸ روز فرصت خواهد داشت تا برای تشکیل دولت به توافق برسد. این مهلت ممکن است ۱۴ روز دیگر تمدید شود.

یکی از گزینه‌های پیش روی او تشکیل دولتی اقلیت با حمایت احزاب عرب در رای‌گیری‌های کلیدی پارلمان است. جلب حمایت احزاب مذهبی یهودیان ارتدوکس افراطی یا تشکیل دولت وحدت ملی با نتانیاهو نیز از دیگر گزینه‌های احتمالی به شمار می‌روند.

با این حال، آیزنکوت پیش‌تر اعلام کرده است که حاضر نیست در دولتی به همراه نتانیاهو حضور داشته باشد. تحلیلگران نیز دستیابی به توافق بر سر هر یک از این گزینه‌ها را دشوار ارزیابی می‌کنند.

اگر آیزنکوت موفق به تشکیل دولت نشود، فرصت به نامزد دیگری داده خواهد شد. در صورت ادامه بن‌بست سیاسی و ناکامی تلاش‌های بعدی، احتمال برگزاری انتخابات مجدد وجود دارد.

ساعتی پیش از اعلام تصمیم هرتسوگ، بنیامین نتانیاهو، نخست‌وزیر اسرائیل، هشدار داد که تشکیل ائتلافی احتمالی میان احزاب مخالف و احزاب عرب که او آنها را «اسلام‌گرا» نامید، به فروپاشی کشور منجر خواهد شد.

نتانیاهو در یک سخنرانی ویدیویی از پیش ضبط‌شده گفت: «چنین دولتی که به اسلام‌گرایان وابسته باشد، کشور اسرائیل را از درون متلاشی خواهد کرد، همان‌طور که این اتفاق در کشورهای اروپایی در حال وقوع است، و حتی بسیار بدتر از آن.»

آیزنکوت ۶۶ ساله، فرمانده پیشین ارتش اسرائیل است که در سال ۲۰۲۲ وارد عرصه سیاست شد. او پس از حمله حماس به اسرائیل در هفتم اکتبر ۲۰۲۳ برای مدتی در کابینه جنگی نتانیاهو حضور داشت، اما بعد به صف مخالفان دولت بازگشت.

او در سال‌های اخیر با انتقاد از نحوه مدیریت جنگ غزه از سوی نتانیاهو، خشونت شهرک‌نشینان اسرائیلی علیه فلسطینیان را نیز محکوم کرده است.

آیزنکوت که پسر و دو برادرزاده‌اش را در جنگ غزه از دست داده، در مبارزات انتخاباتی بر سوابق نظامی و امنیتی خود تاکید کرده است.

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Kevin Carter/Getty Images)

Secret Service officers arrested an armed Venezuelan illegal immigrant near the White House Thursday night after he allegedly threatened to kill President Donald Trump.

Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos allegedly told officers that voices in his head had directed him to come to Washington and kill Trump, according to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). The complaint affidavit filed with his criminal complaint in D.C. Superior Court makes no mention of those remarks, ABC News reported.

A Secret Service officer on patrol spotted a blue Ford F-150 parked on Constitution Avenue shortly before midnight, according to the affidavit. The pickup had been reported stolen. (RELATED: EXCLUSIVE: ICE Drops New Batch Of Illegal Immigrants Accused Of Voter Fraud Ahead Of Midterms)

The officer knocked on the window and asked about weapons. Guanipa Chrinos allegedly nodded and shaped his hand into a gun, the affidavit stated. He climbed out of the truck and spoke to investigators through Google Translate.

Thanks to our brave Secret Service officers, this criminal illegal alien with three firearms in his vehicle was arrested near the White House before he could harm anyone. On top of threatening President Trump, he is an illegal alien from Venezuela who was RELEASED into our country by the Biden administration. He had NO business being in our country in the first place. This is just one example of the incredible work done by the men and women of the Secret Service every single day as they put their lives on the line to protect our nation’s leaders. It’s an honor to work alongside Director Sean Curran and all of the patriots at the U.S. Secret Service.

“I have the gun because they tried to kill me with it, and I had to take it away from them; it’s in the brown bag,” according to the affidavit.

A search of the pickup produced an AR-15 rifle, a MAC-10 machine pistol, a Glock 43x handgun and dozens of rounds of ammunition, ABC reported. He faces three counts each of unlawful transportation of a firearm, possessing an unregistered firearm and possessing unregistered ammunition, Fox News reported.

Additional counts cover carrying a rifle outside a home or business, possession of certain dangerous weapons, carrying a pistol without a license, unauthorized use of a motor vehicle, theft and receiving stolen property, DHS stated.

Guanipa Chrinos remains held without bond following an initial appearance Friday in D.C. Superior Court, ABC reported. The U.S. Marshals Service holds him under an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detainer, according to Fox News.

He entered the United States through Texas in March 2024 and was arrested by Border Patrol before being released, DHS stated. That release happened under the Biden administration, Fox News reported.

“Thanks to our brave Secret Service officers, this illegal alien with three firearms in his vehicle was arrested near the White House before he could harm anyone,” Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said in a statement.

Secret Service Director Sean Curran said armed individuals continue approaching the White House complex amid a heightened threat environment, CNN reported.

Trump survived a July 2024 shooting at a Butler, Pennsylvania, campaign rally that killed one attendee, CBS reported.

افسران سرویس مخفی پنج شنبه شب یک مهاجر غیرقانونی ونزوئلایی مسلح را در نزدیکی کاخ سفید پس از اینکه گفته می شود دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا را تهدید به قتل کرده بود، دستگیر کردند. به گفته وزارت امنیت داخلی (DHS)، رونی یوردریکس گوانیپا کرینوس به افسران گفته است که صداهایی در ذهنش به او دستور داده است که به واشنگتن بیاید و ترامپ را بکشد. به گزارش ای بی سی نیوز، در سوگندنامه شکایتی که همراه با شکایت کیفری او در دادگاه عالی دی سی ثبت شد، هیچ اشاره ای به این اظهارات نشده است. طبق این سوگندنامه، یک افسر سرویس مخفی در حال گشت زنی یک فورد F-150 آبی رنگ را که کمی قبل از نیمه شب در خیابان قانون اساسی پارک شده بود، مشاهده کرد. وانت به سرقت رفته بود. (مرتبط: انحصاری: ICE دسته جدیدی از مهاجران غیرقانونی متهم به تقلب در رأی دهندگان را پیش از انتخابات میان دوره ای منتشر می کند) افسر پنجره را زد و از اسلحه پرسید. گوانیپا کرینوس گویا سر تکان داد و دستش را به شکل تفنگ درآورد. او از کامیون خارج شد و از طریق Google Translate با بازرسان صحبت کرد. با تشکر از افسران شجاع سرویس مخفی ما، این بیگانه غیرقانونی جنایتکار با سه سلاح گرم در وسیله نقلیه خود قبل از اینکه بتواند به کسی آسیب برساند، در نزدیکی کاخ سفید دستگیر شد. علاوه بر تهدید رئیس جمهور ترامپ، او یک بیگانه غیرقانونی از ونزوئلا است که توسط دولت بایدن در کشور ما آزاد شد. او در وهله اول هیچ کاری برای حضور در کشور ما نداشت. این تنها یک نمونه از کارهای باورنکردنی است که توسط مردان و زنان انجام شده است

news.originalContent:
Photo by Heather Diehl/Getty Images

Some of the latest artificial intelligence startups apparently want to work in your place and predict your next moves.

Startups such as 42AI, Lebensstimmen and Orchid have launched AI tools that take over office work, anticipate the probability behind human action and prepare messages to use after you die. As the number of ideas to innovate AI and potentially replace human workers increases, Americans worry about how these products will impact them.

42AI, an Israeli startup that received $62.5 million in funding Monday, said it uncovered the rules that determine human behavior to create its prediction. (RELATED: ‘Rocky Balboa,’ ‘Superman Cash’ And ‘Fat Boy’ Allegedly Hit Hospitals, Bank In $129 Million AI Con)

“[W]e asked a more fundamental question: does behavior have rules, a kind of physics? We spent three years bringing together neuroscience, psychology, psychiatry and AI to answer it, and the answer is yes,” CEO Amit Gal Or told the Daily Caller News Foundation, when asked how the company’s prediction model works. “Behavior is always probabilistic.”

The company’s Behavioral World Model, part of its two-model “brain with two hemispheres,” studies how a person reacts across many unrelated moments, from signing up for a service to placing and canceling an order, to learn what drives them, Gal Or said.

He clarified that demographic and personal data, like names, were excluded from the model, and adding those details did not assist the model’s effectiveness.

“Long term, we want to be the behavioral layer for future AI,” Gal Or told the DNCF. “As robots and AI agents move into the world, they need to understand people.”

Orchid, a Canadian AI startup, launched a model called Keiki that empowers businesses to train AI agents that tackle every step in work for customers.

“A company connects the tools it already uses, like its calendar, store, payments and inbox. It writes down how the work should be done, and the agent takes it from there,” Nizar Abi Zaher, CEO of Orchid, told the DCNF in a statement likely generated by AI. “The agent talks with customers over text, iMessage, WhatsApp, email and Slack, takes the action, and reports back.”

“That’s what ‘take your jobs’ means to us: the agent takes the work off a person’s plate and gets it done,” Abi Zaher told the DCNF.

The company’s marketing for its personal AI has been blunt.

“Introducing Keiki, the first AI built to take your jobs,” Orchid wrote in an Oct. 8 X post launching its model.

Introducing Keiki, the first AI built to take your jobs 🏇 https://t.co/1tMBoHM1wm

“I’m telling you man, AI is gonna fucking kill us,” one of the individuals says in the advertisement video.

Austrian startup Lebenstimmen lets people use AI to record farewell messages and funeral speeches to be played after their death.

”Let me be clear: no content is ever created in a person’s name after their death without their prior consent,” Lebensstimmen co-founder and CEO Phillipp Berkessy told the DCNF. “Lebensstimmen does not replace existing funeral rituals or pastoral care. It complements them with dignity in digital form, and is offered mainly through funeral homes, pre-planning providers and insurance companies.”

Berkessy explained that the AI speaker conveys deceased individual’s pre-recorded messages without appearing like an imitation. The company’s product is not like deepfake technology because the individual puts words in their own mouth, he told the DCNF.

“[W]e are not building a way to imitate someone; we are building a way for a person to decide during their lifetime what will remain of them. It is an innovative, entirely new form of remembrance,” Berkessy added.

Former Red Bull advisor Helmut Marko invested in the company in October, according to GPBlog.

The company plans to launch its first products in early 2027, Berkessy said. Lebensstimmen is known internationally as Words That Remain.

عکس هدر دیهل/گتی ایماژ
برخی از جدیدترین استارت‌آپ‌های هوش مصنوعی ظاهراً می‌خواهند در جای شما کار کنند و حرکت‌های بعدی شما را پیش‌بینی کنند. استارت‌آپ‌هایی مانند 42AI، Lebensstimmen و Orchid ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی را راه‌اندازی کرده‌اند که کار اداری را به دست می‌گیرند، احتمال فعالیت‌های انسانی را پیش‌بینی می‌کنند و پیام‌هایی را برای استفاده پس از مرگ آماده می‌کنند. با افزایش تعداد ایده‌ها برای نوآوری هوش مصنوعی و جایگزینی بالقوه کارگران، آمریکایی‌ها نگران این هستند که این محصولات چگونه بر آنها تأثیر می‌گذارند.42AI، یک استارت‌آپ اسرائیلی که روز دوشنبه 62.5 میلیون دلار بودجه دریافت کرد، گفت که قوانینی را که رفتار انسان را تعیین می‌کند تا پیش‌بینی خود را ایجاد کند، کشف کرده است. (مرتبط: «راکی بالبوآ»، «سوپرمن نقد» و «پسر چاق» که گفته می‌شود به بیمارستان‌ها برخورد کرده‌اند، بانکی با 129 میلیون دلار هدر رفت هوش مصنوعی) آمیت گال اور، مدیر عامل شرکت، در پاسخ به این سوال که مدل پیش‌بینی این شرکت چگونه کار می‌کند، گفت: «[ما یک سؤال اساسی‌تر پرسیدیم: آیا رفتار قوانین، نوعی فیزیک دارد؟ ما سه سال را صرف گردآوری علوم اعصاب، روان‌شناسی، روان‌پزشکی و هوش مصنوعی کردیم تا به آن پاسخ دهیم، و پاسخ مثبت است». "رفتار همیشه احتمالی است." گال اور گفت که مدل دنیای رفتاری این شرکت، بخشی از دو مدل «مغز با دو نیمکره» آن، نحوه واکنش یک فرد را در بسیاری از لحظات غیرمرتبط، از ثبت نام در یک سرویس گرفته تا ثبت و لغو سفارش، برای یادگیری عواملی که آنها را هدایت می‌کند، بررسی می‌کند.

(Photo by RONALDO SCHEMIDT / AFP via Getty Images)

Houston police will no longer alert federal immigration agents during routine traffic stops, three days after Democrats swept every statewide office in Texas.

Democratic Mayor John Whitmire signed an executive order Friday narrowing when officers may contact Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). Two conditions must now apply together. The person has to be arrested on a jailable charge and has to carry an ICE administrative warrant, according to the Texas Tribune. Officers will cite and release people in minor nonviolent cases.

Whitmire tied the switch to Tuesday’s results. “If they’re charged with a new crime, we’ll let ICE know as we get them to the jailhouse,” he said in an interview with The New York Times. “We just are not going to deal with the nonviolent contacts.” (RELATED: EXCLUSIVE: Trump ‘Will Never Allow For Mass Amnesty’ After Floating Working With Dems On Immigration)

Senate Bill 4, a 2017 state law, bars police departments from limiting cooperation with federal immigration authorities, the Tribune reported. Whitmire voted against that bill as a state lawmaker. Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa takes office in January.

After Democrats swept statewide elections in Texas, Houston Mayor John Whitmire said Friday he has directed the Houston Police Department to change its policy on contact with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, saying the move is intended to reduce fear and anxiety in the community.🔗https://t.co/VGa4Oo0CnE

City Council scrapped a rule in April requiring officers to wait 30 minutes for ICE agents at traffic stops. Republican Gov. Greg Abbott threatened roughly $110 million in state public safety grants, arguing the measure violated SB 4. The council then rewrote the ordinance.

“The governor was requiring us to contact ICE,” Whitmire told the Times. “It created a lot of anxiety.”

The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) answered within hours. “We remain disappointed that sanctuary politicians seek to limit cooperation with ICE, as our law enforcement are simply fulfilling their sworn duties to serve and protect our communities,” a spokesperson stated to KPRC 2.

Houston police contacted ICE at least 107 times during the first eight months of 2025, the Houston Chronicle reported. The department logged nine such contacts in all of 2024.

A Harris County grand jury indicted ICE officer Mario Alberto Morales last month on a charge of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon, according to CBS News. District Attorney Sean Teare said Morales ran over a man’s legs with a vehicle during an Oct. 10 pursuit. ICE called the indictment “nothing more than a political stunt by Houston sanctuary politicians,” according to the Tribune.

City Controller Chris Hollins called the order “a promising first step,” the Tribune reported. “ICE killing a man in our city and running over another wasn’t enough to move the mayor. I’m glad an election was,” Hollins stated.

“I had a good relationship with Abbott and the lieutenant governor,” Whitmire told the Times. “But I have even better relationships with the Democrats.”

(عکس از رونالدو شیمیدت / خبرگزاری فرانسه از طریق گتی ایماژ)
سه روز پس از اینکه دموکرات‌ها تمامی دفاتر ایالتی در تگزاس را در نوردیدند، پلیس هیوستون دیگر به ماموران مهاجرت فدرال هشدار نمی‌دهد. اکنون باید دو شرط با هم اعمال شود. به گفته تگزاس تریبون، این شخص باید به اتهام زندانی شدن دستگیر شود و باید یک حکم اداری ICE داشته باشد. افسران افراد را در موارد جزئی غیرخشونت آمیز ذکر کرده و آزاد خواهند کرد. ویتمیر تغییر را به نتایج روز سه شنبه گره زد. او در مصاحبه ای با نیویورک تایمز گفت: "اگر آنها به جرم جدیدی متهم شوند، به ICE اطلاع می دهیم تا آنها را به زندان ببریم." ما فقط با تماس های غیرخشونت آمیز برخورد نمی کنیم. (مرتبط: انحصاری: ترامپ پس از کار شناور با دموکرات ها در مورد مهاجرت، «هرگز اجازه عفو گسترده را نخواهد داد»)
به گزارش تریبون، لایحه 4 سنا، یک قانون ایالتی در سال 2017، ادارات پلیس را از محدود کردن همکاری با مقامات فدرال مهاجرت منع می کند. ویتمیر به عنوان قانونگذار ایالتی به آن لایحه رأی منفی داد. فرماندار منتخب جینا هینوجوسا در ژانویه کار خود را آغاز می کند. پس از پیروزی دموکرات‌ها در انتخابات سراسری تگزاس، جان ویتمیر، شهردار هیوستون، روز جمعه گفت که به اداره پلیس هیوستون دستور داده است تا سیاست خود را در ارتباط با اداره مهاجرت و گمرک ایالات متحده تغییر دهد و گفت که این اقدام به منظور کاهش ترس و اضطراب در جامعه است.

‌پلیس اعلام کرده است که در پی وقوع تیراندازی در میدان اصلی شهر کراکوف لهستان، شش نفر کشته و دستکم ۱۲ نفر دیگر، از جمله شماری از مأموران پلیس، زخمی شده‌اند. به گفته مقامات حال یکی از مجروحان پلیس «وخیم» گزارش شده است.

پلیس منطقه مالوپولسکا در بیانیه‌ای در شبکه اجتماعی ایکس اعلام کرد که حدود ساعت ۳  بعد از ظهر به وقت محلی، مردی که با خودروی وارد میدان شده بود، از «داخل خودرو به سوی مردم تیراندازی کرد.»

در بیانیه دیگری آمده است که ضارب هدف گلوله پلیس قرار گرفته و به بیمارستان منتقل شده است. گزارش شده است که ضارب «لباس نظامی» برتن داشته است.

پلیس منطقه مالوپولسکا همچنین اعلام کرد فرد مظنون به دست داشتن در این حادثه در بازداشت است و گزارش‌ها درباره جست‌وجو برای یافتن مظنونی دیگر را تکذیب کرد.

وزیر کشور لهستان گفته است که دلیلی وجود ندارد که تصور شود بیش از یک مهاجم در این حادثه دست داشته است.

او در اظهاراتی اضافه کرد که به نظر می‌رسد مهاجم «دیدگاه‌های بسیار افراطی» داشته است و در خودرویی که هدایت آن را بر عهده داشته است «تعداد زیادی سلاح» پیدا شده است.

به گفته او، مهاجم شهروند لهستان، ۲۵ ساله بوده و بازرسی از محل سکونتش نیز در جریان است.

دونالد توسک، نخست‌وزیر لهستان، اعلام کرد که وزیر کشور او را در جریان آخرین تحولات مربوط به تیراندازی مرگبار در شهر کراکوف قرار داده است.

او افزود: « پلیس در حال بررسی انگیزه‌ها و تمامی ابعاد و جزئیات این حمله است.»

کارول ناوروکی، رئیس‌جمهور لهستان، هم گفته است که از گزارش‌ها درباره «حوادث تلخ» در کراکوف عمیقا نگران است و به قربانیان، مجروحان و خانواده‌هایشان فکر می‌کند.

گزارش‌ها حاکیست که وزیر کشور لهستان به  کراکوف رفته است.

اکنون در مرکز شهر کراکوف، حضور نیروهای پلیس بسیار پررنگ است.

میدان اصلی در مرکز کراکوف در میان گردشگران بسیار محبوب است. هرچند در مقایسه با تابستان تعداد گردشگران کمتری اکنون در شهر حضور دارند، اما به گفته شاهدان حوالی زمان تیراندازی میدان پر از جمعیت بود.

دور تا دور این میدان میدان کافه‌، بار و رستوران‌ قرار دارد و چون امروز شنبه است، معمولا افراد زیادی در این مکان‌ها حضور دارند.

تام رز، سفیر آمریکا در لهستان، در اظهاراتی این حادثه را «حمله‌ای وحشیانه و مرگبار توصیف کرده که آرامش لهستان را در هم شکسته است.»

‌پلیس اعلام کرده است که در پی وقوع تیراندازی در میدان اصلی شهر کراکوف لهستان، شش نفر کشته و دستکم ۱۲ نفر دیگر، از جمله شماری از مأموران پلیس، زخمی شده‌اند. به گفته مقامات حال یکی از مجروحان پلیس «وخیم» گزارش شده است.

پلیس منطقه مالوپولسکا در بیانیه‌ای در شبکه اجتماعی ایکس اعلام کرد که حدود ساعت ۳  بعد از ظهر به وقت محلی، مردی که با خودروی وارد میدان شده بود، از «داخل خودرو به سوی مردم تیراندازی کرد.»

در بیانیه دیگری آمده است که ضارب هدف گلوله پلیس قرار گرفته و به بیمارستان منتقل شده است. گزارش شده است که ضارب «لباس نظامی» برتن داشته است.

پلیس منطقه مالوپولسکا همچنین اعلام کرد فرد مظنون به دست داشتن در این حادثه در بازداشت است و گزارش‌ها درباره جست‌وجو برای یافتن مظنونی دیگر را تکذیب کرد.

وزیر کشور لهستان گفته است که دلیلی وجود ندارد که تصور شود بیش از یک مهاجم در این حادثه دست داشته است.

او در اظهاراتی اضافه کرد که به نظر می‌رسد مهاجم «دیدگاه‌های بسیار افراطی» داشته است و در خودرویی که هدایت آن را بر عهده داشته است «تعداد زیادی سلاح» پیدا شده است.

به گفته او، مهاجم شهروند لهستان، ۲۵ ساله بوده و بازرسی از محل سکونتش نیز در جریان است.

دونالد توسک، نخست‌وزیر لهستان، اعلام کرد که وزیر کشور او را در جریان آخرین تحولات مربوط به تیراندازی مرگبار در شهر کراکوف قرار داده است.

او افزود: « پلیس در حال بررسی انگیزه‌ها و تمامی ابعاد و جزئیات این حمله است.»

کارول ناوروکی، رئیس‌جمهور لهستان، هم گفته است که از گزارش‌ها درباره «حوادث تلخ» در کراکوف عمیقا نگران است و به قربانیان، مجروحان و خانواده‌هایشان فکر می‌کند.

گزارش‌ها حاکیست که وزیر کشور لهستان به  کراکوف رفته است.

اکنون در مرکز شهر کراکوف، حضور نیروهای پلیس بسیار پررنگ است.

میدان اصلی در مرکز کراکوف در میان گردشگران بسیار محبوب است. هرچند در مقایسه با تابستان تعداد گردشگران کمتری اکنون در شهر حضور دارند، اما به گفته شاهدان حوالی زمان تیراندازی میدان پر از جمعیت بود.

دور تا دور این میدان میدان کافه‌، بار و رستوران‌ قرار دارد و چون امروز شنبه است، معمولا افراد زیادی در این مکان‌ها حضور دارند.

تام رز، سفیر آمریکا در لهستان، در اظهاراتی این حادثه را «حمله‌ای وحشیانه و مرگبار توصیف کرده که آرامش لهستان را در هم شکسته است.»

news.originalContent:
رونو لمارکی، معاون نماینده ویژه ملل متحد در افغانستان، می‌گوید که با کاهش کمک‌های بشردوستانه در یک سال اخیر انتظار می‌رود  تا «۷۰۰ مرکز صحی» تا پایان سال ۲۰۲۶ در این کشور تعطیل شوند. به باور او بسته شدن این مراکز  منجر به فروپاشی خدمات صحی و درمانی در این کشور می‌شوند.

کاهش کمک‌های بشردوستانه به افغانستان از اوت ۲۰۲۱ به اینسو بحران انسانی را در این کشور تشدید کرده است. از سویی هم بازگشت ۶ تا ۸ میلیون مهاجر از کشورهای همسایه به افغانستان بار سنگین‌تری به وضعیت شکننده افغانستان تحمیل کرده است.

شماری از افغان‌ها می‌گویند که نبود خدمات بهداشتی و درمانی آنها را مجبور می‌کند به شهرهای بزرگتر پناه ببرند.

افزایش تقاضا برای خدمات صحی، رسیدگی به بیماران را حتی در بیمارستان‌های شهرهای بزرگ مانند کابل، پایتخت،  دشوار می‌کند.

رونو لمارکی که پس از بازدید از هشت ولایت افغانستان به ایالات متحده آمریکا بازگشته است می‌گوید که کاهش کمک‌های انسانی رسیدگی به خدمات را دشوارتر کرده و نیازهای اولیه را در این کشور تشدید می‌بخشد.

او هشدار داد که کاهش بودجه و قطع کمک‌ها پیامدهای جدی بر وضعیت بهداشتی و سلامتی مردم افغانستان خواهد داشت: «من بخش صحت و درمان را مثال می‌زنم. این بخش در حال فروپاشی است. انتظار می‌رود از ۲۰۲۵ تا ۲۰۲۶ چهل درصد مراکز ارائه خدمات اولیه بهداشتی و درمانی در تعطیل شوند. این به معنی ۷۰۰ بخش ارائه خدمات اولیه صحی از مجموع ۱۹۰۰ بخش در سراسر کشور است.»

او تأکید کرد که پیامد‌ها « بسیار جدی» خواهند بود.

کمبود کمک‌های بشردوستانه در ارائه خدمات بهداشتی و درمانی به وضوح مشاهده می‌شود که بر اثر آن افراد آسیب‌پذیر از جمله زنان باردار و کودکان را بیش از همه متأثر می‌کند.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

مریم (نام مستعار) که در یکی از ولایت‌های افغانستان زندگی می‌کند، جنین هفت ماهه‌اش را به علت نبود کلینیک در از دست داد، چون برای معاینات دوره بارداری باید فاصله‌ زیادی را می‌پیمود.

او به بی‌بی‌سی گفت به سبب کمبود دکتر در آن کلینیک نتوانست به طور منظم معاینه شود. مریم افزود: «در ماه هفتم، درد شدید داشتم، زمانی که طرف کلینیک حرکت کردم راه بسیار دور بود نتوانستم سر وقت برسم. وقتی به کلینیک رسیدم دکتری وجود نداشت که مشکل مرا بررسی کند. پس از چند ساعت انتظار زمانی که دکترها مرا معاینه کردند به من گفتند که طفل در شکمم فوت کرده است.»

زنی دیگری که اکنون باردار است به بی‌بی‌سی گفت: «زمانی که [به مراکز صحی] می‌روم هیچ گونه خدمات صحی وجود ندارد. به وضعیت من و طفلکم توجه نمی‌شود. در ماه نهم بارداری هستم. خودم مریض هستم کلیه‎‌هایم  درد می‌کنه و پاهایم ورم دارد.»

یک زن که به تازگی پدرش را از دست داده می‌گوید که در ولایت محل سکونت‌شان خدمات درمانی استاندارد وجود ندارد و دکترها نتوانستند او را مداوا کنند. آنان تصمیم گرفتند پدرشان را برای مداوا به کابل ببرند. اما او در مسیر راه درگذشت.

نه تنها زنان، بلکه افرادی که نیاز به مراقبت‌های بهداشتی دارند، از کمبود دکتر و نبود امکانات بهداشتی گلایه دارد.

مردی که به بیماری قند و مشکلات معده مبتلا است، نیز در گفت‌وگو با بی‌بی‌سی از عدم دسترسی به خدمات مناسب شکایت کرد و گفت وقتی به شفاخانه‌ها مراجعه می‌کند هم خدمات لازم را دریافت نمی‌کند.

او گفت: «مشکلات معده دارم و قند خونم هم بالاست، در شفاخانه‌ها هم خدماتی نیست که مشکل من مداوا شود.»

در سال‌های اخیر با مهاجرت گسترده افغان‌ها به کشورهای دیگر دکتران و کارکنان بهداشتی و درمانی زیادی نیز از کشور خارج شدند؛ موردی که شکاف عظیم در سیستم  خدمان بهداشتی و درمانی کشور ایجاد کرد.

بر اساس آمار سازمان بهداشت در افغانستان به ازای هر ۱۰ هزار نفر تنها حدود ۱۰ کارمند صحی وجود دارد. در حالی که برای دسترسی همگانی به خدمات درمانی و بهداشتی این رقم باید به حدود ۴۴ نفر برسد.

آماری دقیق از شمار نیروهای تخصصی بهداشتی و درمانی که افغانستان را ترک کرده اند وجود ندارد اما یک مسئول از شبکه‌ای از شفاخانه‌های خصوصی که نخواست نامش افشا شود به بی‌بی‌سی گفت که در پنج سال اخیر در بسیاری از رشته‌های تخصصی شمار دکتران با تجربه پنجاه تا شصت درصد کاهش یافته است.

به گفته کارکنان درمانی این کمبودها در ولایت‌های دور افتاده بیشتر احساس می‌شود؛ جایی که نیاز به دریافت خدمات صحی بیشتر است.

اما وضعیت در شهرهای بزرگ نیز بهتر نیست. دکتر شیرزاد، کارمند یکی از بیمارستان‌های کابل می‌گوید: «پس از سال ۲۰۲۱ شماری از دکترها، پرستاران و کارکنان درمانی افغانستان را ترک کردند. برای برخی نگرانی‌های امنیتی و محدودیت‌های وضع شده از سوی طالبان سبب شد تا در جستجوی فرصت‌های بهتر کاری و اقتصادی راهی کشورهای دیگر شوند.»

هجوم بیجا شدگان داخلی به شهرهای بزرگ و بازگشت افغان‌ها از کشورهای همسایه نظام  بهداشتی و خدمات درمانی را تحت فشار مضاعف قرار داده است.

با این‌حال سازمان جهانی صحت در نیمه سال ۲۰۲۵ هشدار داده بود که کمبود بودجه ممکن است منجر به تعطیلی ۸۰ درصد از مراکز خدمات اولیه بهداشتی و درمانی شود که تحت حمایت از سازمان قرار دارند.

بسته شدن این مراکز صحی میلیون‌ها نفر از جمله گروه‌های آسیب‌پذیر مانند زنان،‌ کودکان،‌ سالمندان، بیجاشدگان داخلی و بازگشت‌کنندگان را از دسترسی به مراقبت‌های صحی حیاتی محروم می‌سازد.

سازمان نجات کودکان حدود سه ماه پیش خبر داده بود که ۶۰۰ مرکز صحی در افغانستان به دلیل کاهش بودجه تعطیل یا فعالیت‌شان متوقف شده است. وضعیتی که در نتیجه آن حدود چهار میلیون نفر را متاثر می‌سازد. سازمان نجات کودکان گفت که نیمی از این افراد کودکان اند.

رونو لمارکی همچنان هشدار داد که افزایش فقر، ضعف در ارائه خدمات عمومی و ناکامی در ادغام بازگشت‌کنندگان می‌تواند پیامدهای فراتر از مرزهای افغانستان داشته باشد و بر امنیت،‌ ثبات منطقه و روند مهاجرت تأثیر بگذارد.

او تأکید کرد که جامعه جهانی نباید افغانستان را در شرایط کنونی تنها بگذارد.
